name: contract-extraction
description: Extract key terms from a contract or legal agreement with cited provenance

steps.description: Parse the document into structured content (PDF, DOCX, or web page)
Extract key terms using Cited[T] fields (effective date, parties, governing law, termination provisions, indemnification, liability caps)
Verify every extracted term cites an exact verbatim quote from the source
steps.note: The Grounded wrapper handles this automatically

steps.description: Output structured results with each term linked to its source page and paragraph
